items.title: 9.2.2.1 Software for Business Plan Creation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of business-plan software (PDF 211).

blocks.text: Business-plan software munazzam sanche, maali modelling aur rehnumai deta hai. Chhoti online kitabon ki dukaan shuru karne ke liye PlanGuru ya Enloop jaise auzaar retail ka sancha chunne dete hain jo overview aur market analysis jaise hisson mein rehnumai karta hai. Maali calculators inventory, website aur marketing ke kharche le kar sales aur cash flow ke andaze charts ke saath banate hain, jis se investors ke saamne pesh karna ya funding ke liye darkhwast aasan hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Cash flow kya hai, aur is ka andaza kyun ahem hai?
blocks.explanation: Cash flow waqt ke saath aane aur jane wala paisa hai; andaza dikhata hai ke har mahine bill ada karne ko kafi naqd hoga ya nahi. Yeh tareef aam ilm hai.

items: Plan software: sanche, maali calculators, charts (PlanGuru, Enloop).
